VisionPage.heroQuote: "The harvest is plentiful, but the workers are few. Ask the Lord of the harvest, therefore, to send out workers into his harvest field."
VisionPage.mandateText1: Great Harvest Ministries is more than an organization; it is a spiritual movement birthed from a profound encounter with God's heart for the nations. Our calling is not simply to gather crowds, but to make disciples who can carry the culture of Heaven into every sphere of society.
VisionPage.mandateText2: We believe that true transformation happens when believers are equipped with the uncompromised Word of God and the undeniable power of the Holy Spirit.
VisionPage.pillar1Text: We prioritize the presence and direction of the Holy Spirit above all strategies. Every decision, service, and outreach is born out of intimacy with God in prayer.
VisionPage.pillar2Text: We exist for those who are not yet here. Our focus remains outward, consistently seeking to reach the lost and demonstrate the love of Christ in tangible ways.
VisionPage.pillar3Text: We look beyond our local congregation to the broader Body of Christ, partnering globally to see God's will done on earth as it is in heaven.
VisionPage.joinText: There is a place for you in this harvest. Discover how you can partner with us through prayer, serving, or financial generosity.

BeliefsPage.heroSubtitle: The core theological convictions that anchor our movement and guide our mission.

bible.title: The Bible
bible.content: We believe the Bible is the inspired, infallible, and authoritative Word of God. It is the supreme source of truth for Christian beliefs and living.

trinity.title: The Trinity
trinity.content: We believe in one God, eternally existent in three persons: Father, Son, and Holy Spirit. Each person of the Trinity possesses equally all the attributes of deity.

salvation.title: Salvation
salvation.content: We believe that salvation is a free gift of God's grace, received through faith in Jesus Christ alone. It cannot be earned through human effort or good works.

holySpirit.title: The Holy Spirit
holySpirit.content: We believe in the present ministry of the Holy Spirit, whose indwelling enables the Christian to live a godly life and empowers them for service with spiritual gifts.

church.title: The Church
church.content: We believe the Church is the body of Christ, composed of all born-again believers. Its mission is to make disciples of all nations and demonstrate God's love to the world.

eschatology.title: Eschatology
eschatology.content: We believe in the blessed hope: the personal, visible return of the Lord Jesus Christ to earth and the establishment of His kingdom.
